name: Windows Event & Application Log Explorer
description: Fast query, filtering, and AI-assisted root-cause analysis for Windows Application, System, and Security Event Logs.

tools.name: Query Windows Event Channel
tools.description: Queries Application, System, or Security event channels via native wevtutil XML/structured parsing.

tools.name: Filter Events by ID & Source
tools.description: Extracts targeted Windows events (e.g., 1000 App Error, 1002 App Hang, 41 Kernel-Power, 7034 Service Crash).

tools.name: AI Root-Cause Log Analysis
tools.description: Sends selected event log entries to the Central LLM Service for diagnostic root-cause analysis (subject to Off-LAN trust gating).
